calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 5
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT MAX(sale_date) as latest_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 118
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = false
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
calls.output_preview:
subcategory | units_sold
Fixings & Fasteners | 560
Indoor Lighting | 150
Cleaning Products | 136
(3 rows)

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) as sales_lines,
  SUM(f.quantity) as total_units_sold,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = true THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) as staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 118
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
calls.output_preview:
fiscal_year | fiscal_period | sales_lines | total_units_sold | staff_units
FY2026/27 | 5 | 1250 | 2245 | 34

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) as units_returned
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 118
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY p.subcategory
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY units_returned DESC
LIMIT 5

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) as units_returned,
  SUM(f.quantity) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END), 0) as net_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 118
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = false
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5

subcategory | units_sold | units_returned | net_units
Fixings & Fasteners | 560 | 6 | 554
Indoor Lighting | 150 | 4 | 146
Cleaning Products | 136 | 1 | 135
Storage Boxes | 136 | 6 | 130
Plants & Flowers | 134 | 6 | 128
(5 rows)

calls.statement:
WITH period_5_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.quantity) DESC) as rank
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 118
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = false
  GROUP BY p.subcategory
)
SELECT 
  rank,
  subcategory,
  units_sold
FROM period_5_sales
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY rank
calls.output_preview:
rank | subcategory | units_sold
1 | Fixings & Fasteners | 560
2 | Indoor Lighting | 150
3 | Cleaning Products | 136
(3 rows)
